'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Emil Wallin DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Typed onto the forum by AnakinSolo. Gogolen: Emil went 3–1 with this list. The matching Dark Xerox is page 2 of [[File:2014 Worlds Day 2 Part 3.pdf]]; Day 2 Light Xerox is page 1 of that PDF (Communing Girl Scouts).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|VB1-D-imperialentanglements-pre.gif|label=Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
